Graph class predicates

Source: R/queries.R
predicates.Rd

Test which class a graph belongs to (is_dag(), is_pdag(), is_cpdag(), is_mpdag(), is_ug(), is_admg(), is_ag(), is_mag(), is_pag()) or structural properties (is_simple(), is_acyclic()).

Usage

is_dag(cg)

is_pdag(cg)

is_cpdag(cg)

is_mpdag(cg)

is_ug(cg)

is_admg(cg)

is_ag(cg)

is_mag(cg)

is_pag(cg)

is_simple(cg)

is_acyclic(cg)

Arguments

cg

A graph created with cgraph(), of any class.

Value

A logical scalar.

Details

These test the actual edge structure of cg, independent of the class it has.

Examples

if (julia_ready()) {
  dag <- cgraph(A %-->% B, class = "PDAG")
  list(
    is_dag = is_dag(dag), # TRUE, even though assigned PDAG
    is_ug = is_ug(dag),
    is_acyclic = is_acyclic(dag)
  )
}
#> $is_dag
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $is_ug
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $is_acyclic
#> [1] TRUE
#>
